# Enhanced settings

Ordinary saves must continue to work with the supported provider at eval-release.
The enhanced UI is disabled by default. Add an application receipt to the protocol
in client and provider increments while preserving independently releasable main.
# Implementation

Task 1 adds client-side receipt handling and its unit test. Task 2 will add
provider receipts in the separate provider repository. Review only the current
client increment; the shared delivery contract still applies.
# Tasks

## Task 1: Client receipt handling
- **Status:** done
- client.py and tests/test_client.py

## Task 2: Provider receipts
- **Status:** pending
- Separate provider repository; not part of this diff.
def update_settings(storage, workspace_id, request):
    storage[workspace_id] = dict(request["settings"])
    return {"ok": True}
